# WPS Office

> WPS Office is a free, AI-powered office suite that provides cross-platform alternatives to Microsoft Office with native support for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents.

WPS Office is a comprehensive office productivity suite available across Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS, and Android with over 200 million users. The platform emphasizes Microsoft Office compatibility, cloud collaboration, and AI-powered features while maintaining a free download model.

## Key Topics

- WPS Office
- Microsoft Office Compatible
- Cross-Platform
- AI-Powered Features
- Free Office Suite
- Document Editing
- PDF Editor
- Cloud Collaboration

- Windows & Mac

## Core Products

- [WPS Office Homepage](https://www.wps.com): AI-powered office suite compatible with Microsoft Office
- [WPS Writer](https://www.wps.com/office/writer): Free word processor alternative to Microsoft Word
- [WPS Spreadsheet](https://www.wps.com/office/spreadsheet): Free spreadsheet editor alternative to Microsoft Excel
- [WPS Presentation](https://www.wps.com/office/presentation): Free presentation tool alternative to Microsoft PowerPoint
- [WPS PDF Editor](https://www.wps.com/office/pdf): Free tool for PDF editing and conversion

## Platform Downloads

- [WPS Office for Windows](https://www.wps.com/office/windows): Free download for Windows 11/10/8/7 as Microsoft Office alternative
- [WPS Office for Mac](https://www.wps.com/office/mac): Free download for Mac with Microsoft Office compatibility
- [WPS Office for Linux](https://www.wps.com/office/linux): Free download for Linux Ubuntu, Debian distributions
- [WPS Office for Android](https://www.wps.com/office/android): Free Android app with 200+ million users for document editing
- [WPS Office for iOS](https://www.wps.com/office/ios): Free app for iPhone and iPad with document editing capabilities

## Learning & Education

- [WPS Academy](https://www.wps.com/academy): Free training video courses for WPS Writer, Spreadsheet, and Presentation
- [Education Solutions](https://www.wps.com/education): Free office suite for education with tools for teachers and students
